name: Match objects and establish anchors
when: Canonicalized objects must be matched and placed using reference images.
procedure: Inspect supplied object geometry and compare distinctive visible features with the references.
Choose an object whose correspondence and location are well constrained by the supplied evidence.
Place that anchor and use reference-supported relative relationships to guide subsequent objects.
verification: Object identities and relative arrangement remain consistent with the reference views.
failure_lessons: Anonymous identifiers do not reveal target placement; do not infer answers from asset filenames.
adaptation_notes: Adapts localization and scene decomposition to target layout; supplied inspection is current geometry only.
